Domain of unknown function (DUF8168) C-terminal domain

family.description: This entry represents the C-terminal domain from a family of uncharacterised proteins found predominantly in Proteobacteria that contain two domains. The proteins are distributed among various orders including Burkholderiales, Rhodobacterales, and Hyphomicrobiales. The proteins in this family are typically around 240 to 250 amino acids in length. This domain contains a conserved RHG motif that may be functionally important. This alpha helical domain belongs to the Hpt superfamily according to CATH.
